title: 本大爷又来了俺是第二章！
slug: 缺爱小可怜重回爸妈十八岁那年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

从前祝予的姥爷还在时，经常给祝予讲祝今也的事情，她数次脑补过自己的妈妈要是活过来，她会对她说什么。

明明幻想无数次，但当这个机会真的像梦境那般送到面前来时，她才发现自己变成了胆小鬼。

“你……你……跑那么快做什么，累累累累死我了……”

祝予像疯了一样跑走后，班长就追了上来。

他扶着墙喘息，有些纳闷地看着之前脸上没什么表情的水母头少女，此时失魂落魄站在他们班窗户前，左手无意识地抠着另一只。

祝予都不知道她是怎么在讲台上做完自我介绍，去到自己的位置上坐下的。

等她回过神的时候，早读已经开始了。

她做贼一样朝着窗边那个位置看了过去，刚瞥见那人的衣角，又似被烫到般猛地将脑袋扭了回来。

不行不行，她还没做好心理准备！

【………你这样搞得我都紧张起来了】

祝予深呼吸一下：【你这叫看人拉屎屁眼刺挠儿】

那道声音：【………】

嗯，这才是它熟悉的祝予。

【自我介绍一下，我是你的时空穿越旅行助手，你可以随意称呼我】

祝予：【刺挠】

刺挠：【………】

祝予低头抠着手指上的死皮，本就惨不忍睹的手指再次被她扯出了血，清晰的感受到刺痛，这才让她心里安稳了些，冷静了下来。

【为什么是我？】

她声音中带着些不解。

刺挠似乎等很久了，见她终于问了，语气颇有些神秘道：【是有人选择了你】

听到回答，祝予怔了一下。

她很认真的想，是不是以前数次许下的愿望，真的被人听到了呢？

不管对方是谁有什么目的，如果有机会，她愿意付出一切报答对方。

【我不是从未来过来的吗，转校生这个身份是怎么回事？】

刚才班主任介绍说她是因为父母工作安排才从城里搬来抚玉镇上的。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the past, when Zhu Yu's grandfather was still alive, he often told Zhu Yu about Zhu Jinye. She thought about what her mother would say to her several times if she came back alive.

She had fantasized about it countless times, but when this opportunity really came to her like a dream, she realized that she had become a coward.

"You... you... why are you running so fast? I'm exhausted..."

After Zhu Yu ran away like crazy, the squad leader chased after her.

He leaned on the wall and panted, looking at the jellyfish-headed girl who had no expression on her face with some confusion. Now she was standing in front of the window of their class in a daze, her left hand unconsciously picking at the other one.

Zhu Yu didn't even know how she finished introducing herself on the podium and sat down in her seat.

By the time she came to her senses, morning reading had already begun.

She looked towards the window by the window like a thief. Just when she caught a glimpse of the man's clothes, she turned her head back as if she had been burned.

No, no, she's not mentally prepared yet!

【……You’re making me nervous】

Zhu Yu took a deep breath and said: [What you call it is scratching someone’s butthole while watching someone poop]

The voice: […………]

Well, this is the familiar blessing.

[Introduce yourself, I am your time travel assistant, you can call me whatever you want]

Wish you: [Tickling]

Stinging: […………]

Zhu Yu lowered her head and picked at the dead skin on her fingers. Her already miserable fingers were torn out and bled again. She clearly felt the sting, which made her feel more at ease and calm down.

【Why me?】

There was some confusion in her voice.

Ji Tiao seemed to have been waiting for a long time. Seeing that she finally asked, she said in a rather mysterious tone: [Someone chose you]

Zhu Yu was startled when he heard the answer.

She thought seriously, had the wishes she made several times in the past really been heard?

No matter who the other person is or what his purpose is, if given the chance, she is willing to do anything to repay him.

[Didn’t I come from the future? What’s going on with my status as a transfer student?】

Just now, the head teacher introduced that she moved to Fuyu Town from the city because of her parents' work arrangements.
